# trust-manager

trust-manager, distributing the lab's CA into every namespace that needs it.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-interface.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bundleName | string | `"lab-ca-bundle"` | Name of the ConfigMap the CA lands in, in every namespace. |
| chart | string | *(required)* | Store path of the trust-manager Helm chart. Required. |
| namespace | string | `"cert-manager"` | Namespace the controller runs in, and the one it reads Bundle sources from. Defaults to cert-manager's, because the CA Secret it reads is there and the controller only looks in one.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | KUBERNETES_CLUSTER | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| issuance | X509_ISSUANCE | Something that signs certificates, and whether a browser will trust what it signs. |
| webhook | X509_WEBHOOK | The certificate controller's admission webhook is serving, so its CRs are accepted. |

## Provides

| promise | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| trust | TRUST_BUNDLE | A CA bundle distributed into namespaces, for workloads that verify the lab's own certificates. |

## Emits

| alias | kind | what it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| component | catallaxy.component | What a floe installs into a cluster: bundles, and the operator surface around them. |
